summary: Artiva Biotherapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 23,871,526 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 2,170,138 shares at $11.52 per share, raising ~$282M in net proceeds. The offering is underwritten by Jefferies, TD Cowen, Cantor, Wedbush PacGrow, and Needham Company, with delivery expected May 11, 2026. This is a routine capital raise by an issuer, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard shelf takedown to fund operations, with no structural or event-driven catalysts. Watch for dilution impact on existing shareholders post-closing.
